Method of Attack: Delivered via phishing emails impersonating U.S. Small Business Administration (U.S. SBA)
Infection chain involving an .IMG file containing an .ISO image that drops a malicious PDF document
PDF drops and executes a VBS script that downloads and launches Remcos RAT from a Google CDN

Once installed, attackers gain full control to steal credentials, browser cookies, execute malicious code, take screenshots, steal clipboard contents, use compromised machines as proxies, and automate tasks
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious attachments camouflaged as disaster assistance grants and testing center vouchers
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious attachment disguised as disaster assistance grants and testing center vouchers
Application number in phishing email urging completion before March 25th
